Get KZS Team Profile

Source: R/kzs.R
kzs_team.Rd

Team profile: club, home hall, colours and the competitions the team entered.

Endpoint: GET https://api.kzs.si/api/v1/public/teams/{team_id}

Usage

kzs_team(team_id)

Arguments

team_id

(required) Team id (team_id in kzs_teams): one club team in one season, e.g. 17551. Not the match-team id nor the club id.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Team profile: club, home hall, colours and the competitions the team entered. An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py kzs_team):

col_nametypedescription
team_idintegerTeam-application id: the team's registration (entry) for the season; play-by-play teamApplicationId is the same key space.
team_application_idintegerTeam-application id: the team's registration (entry) for the season; play-by-play teamApplicationId is the same key space.
club_idintegerClub id: the club across seasons and categories (Ilirija = 16). No captured route is keyed by it.
club_memberlogicalTrue when the club is a KZS member (false on nested copies that omit it).
categorycharacterAge category: ABSOLUTE (senior) or U8-U23 / ANY (code table in kzs-returns.md).
rankcharacterTier: FIRST-FOURTH or TOURNAMENT (code table).
gendercharacterMALE or FEMALE.
sport_hall_idintegerSport hall (venue) id. /sportHalls/{id} is in the site bundle, not captured.
sport_hall_namecharacterName of the venue (sports hall) where the game is played or the team is based.
sport_hall_address_idintegerId of the venue's address record.
sport_hall_address_post_office_idintegerPost-office id (FMS internal).
sport_hall_address_post_office_zip_codecharacterPostal code (REDACTED under a club addresses[] row; kept for venues).
sport_hall_address_post_office_namecharacterPost-office town.
sport_hall_address_post_office_municipalitycharacterMunicipality, upper case.
sport_hall_address_post_office_countrycharacterCountry, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (SI).
sport_hall_address_streetcharacterVenue street (a public sports hall).
sport_hall_address_house_numbercharacterVenue house number, a string ('6 A').
namecharacterTeam name for the season (sponsor name included).
codecharacterTeam 3-letter code.
season_idintegerSeason id: OPAQUE, not a year (1 = 2000/2001 ... 27 = 2026/2027, 31 = 1991/1992). The season name is 'START/END'; the sdv season is the END year (the second half of name).
season_namecharacterSeason, 'START/END' (2025/2026); sdv season = the END year.
season_is_activelogicalTrue for the current season only (2026/2027 on 2026-10-12).
season_activelogicalSame as isActive.
short_namecharacterTeam short name (” when none).
home_jersey_colorcharacterHome jersey colour, hex '#RRGGBB'.
guest_jersey_colorcharacterAway jersey colour, hex.
logo_uuidcharacterLogo: image file id, served at https://api.kzs.si/public/images/{uuid}.
seasonintegerSeason of the registration.
competitionscharacterCompetitions of the team this season (id, name, rule, phases).

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: these wrappers read the public read API (Java/Spring, built by OnixWeb) that the kzs.si site itself calls. No terms of use were located (unverified), api.kzs.si/robots.txt answers 401 and www.kzs.si/robots.txt 404, so no policy or Crawl-delay is published. The runtime waits at least 1 s before every request, retries included. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Personal data: the API serves officials' and coaches' emails, phones and home towns, and clubs' bank accounts and addresses, publicly. The parsers never output them (officials appear by name only; club addresses, personnel and the commissioner report are dropped). Do not add them back.

  • Seasons are END years (2027 = 2026/2027); KZS' own season ids are opaque (27 = 2026/2027) and the runtime maps them. Competition ids are per season. Three team keys are never interchangeable: the match-team id (per match and side), team_id (one club team in one season) and club_id (across seasons). player_id is the registry id, person_id the person behind it.

  • Errors are HTTP 400 for everything (an unknown id and a bad parameter alike), so the runtime raises hoopR_asset_fetch for it, never hoopR_bad_request or an empty frame. List routes default to 150 rows with no truncation signal: every list wrapper asks for a large limit and refuses a full page. The play-by-play and box-score wrappers, the leaderboards, teams, rounds and playing days each make one extra, cached request (the match header or the competition) to prove the answer is the one asked for and the game is final.

  • Coverage: scores from 2007/08; box scores and play-by-play from 2015/16. Some 2020/21 men's games have a box score but no play-by-play (hoopR_no_data): the Genius data.json (genius_match_id in kzs_matches) is the fallback. Shot x/y are Genius court percent; side (LEFT/RIGHT) names the basket end and teams switch ends at half time, so normalise with side before stacking shots. Advanced box-score fields are 0 in every observed game.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (an empty answer or list, a competition without standings, a final game with no play-by-play or box score, HTTP 404), hoopR_asset_fetch (HTTP 400, the API's only error status for an unknown id and a bad parameter alike; any other non-2xx; a non-JSON or empty body; an envelope whose status is not OK; a full list page; a game that is not final; a body for another competition, match, team, player or season than the one asked for) and hoopR_bad_request (a bad argument, before any request). HTTP 500 is retried. Wrappers raise; they never return an empty frame for a failed fetch.

 kzs_team(team_id = 17551)
